utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Have you picked a time for the repair drive yet?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Not yet — I’m still checking with a couple people while I’m out. I’ll let you know as soon as I pin down a time.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Okay, thanks — just let me know once it’s set.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — if the repair drive needs tools, I’ve got a few I can lend.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, thanks Gus — that’d help a lot. I’ll swing by if I need anything.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Anytime, Noah — just let me know what you need and I’ll bring it over.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is getting a good bit of support already — folks have been dropping things off all morning. If you’re thinking of helping out, it sounds like they could really use a few more hands.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That’s good to hear, but I’d want to know the exact time and where they need people most. I can help if the logistics are clear.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’ll check the exact time and the spot they need folks most, then I’ll let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need me to take on?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Sam — could you handle the donation drop-off at the community center and keep an eye on where the extra tools get parked?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’ll handle the donation drop-off and keep track of the extra tools. Just let me know when and where to pick them up.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’m spreading the word about the repair drive—come by if you can, it should be a good turnout!

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Quinn. I’ll try to come by if I’m up to it.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Awesome, Uli — no pressure at all. I’ll save you a spot and keep you posted if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ll help keep the repair drive organized and on track. What do you need from me first, Leo?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, Rosa. Could you start a quick list of volunteers and the repair items they can handle?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ll start a quick volunteer list and match each person with the repair items they can handle.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Sure — what details do you have for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m a bit late to the details, but I can help out — what’s still needed for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Dane — do we already have the date, location, and a list of needed supplies?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around the school schedule—what time are you thinking for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That would be a big help, Faye—maybe Saturday morning around 10? I’m happy to work around the school schedule if that’s easier.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Saturday at 10 works for me—I’ll make sure it fits around the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard the repair drive’s getting a good turnout—did I miss the details on where people should drop things off?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: At the community center parking lot on Saturday morning—there’ll be a labeled drop-off table by the front doors.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, that helps—I’ll swing by Saturday morning and look for the table by the front doors.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, what do you need from me for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, are you asking me to bring tools or supplies for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Supplies would be great — whatever you can bring helps.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m going to stop by and see what still needs fixing. If you’ve got a task in mind, tell me and I’ll keep an eye out for it.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, thanks, Rey — if you see the loose fence panel by my place, that’d be a huge help. I keep meaning to fix it, but I’ve been a bit all over the place.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure — I’ll watch for the loose fence panel and let you know if I spot it.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll swing by the repair drive and let everyone know the plan.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Vik — I’ll keep an eye on the supply table and make sure we’re stocked up.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll pass along the plan and check back with you after I talk to everyone.
